person_note: The quote set repeatedly shows close third-person and free-indirect narration through Ivan, Peter, Margaret, and other characters. Apparent first-person passages are dialogue or direct thought framed by forms such as “he thinks,” while generic or self-addressed “you” passages are gnomic or local free-indirect language rather than a sustained second-person narrator. The authorized extract independently demonstrates third-person narration across Ivan and Margaret, and several credible whole-book reviews explicitly describe close third person with alternating focal perspectives. Alternation of focal character and prose style does not constitute alternation of grammatical narrative person. No credible evidence of sustained first- or second-person base sections was found.
